timing: Specified after data collection and before inspecting aggregate outcomes; this is a pilot analysis, not a preregistered confirmatory study.
primary_contrast: B minus A in mean per-slot reward, equal weight across the five frozen scenarios and twenty paired evaluation seeds, then across three paired training seeds.

uncertainty.training_seed_unit: Three paired training seeds; report all three effects and a paired t interval with df=2, conditional on the fixed evaluation set.
uncertainty.bootstrap: Resample training-seed indices and evaluation-seed indices as crossed clusters, preserving all five scenarios and all compared methods together. For rule vs rule, resample evaluation seeds only.
uncertainty.limits: Only three independent training runs per learned condition. Bootstrap and t intervals are exploratory, scenario and secondary metric intervals are unadjusted for multiple comparisons. A confidence interval covering zero does not establish equivalence.

integrity_checks: Reconcile episode summaries against every raw trajectory
Match exogenous channel hashes within scenario and evaluation seed
Check configs, frozen sources, profile and final model hashes
Check same-seed initialization and A/B configuration differences
diagnostics: Per-seed training reward curves and last-20-percent trend
Mode distributions, resource share imbalance, and scheduling-weight variation
Check the exact meaning of reported quality and reward
scope: Read existing frozen training and evaluation records. Preserve raw files, models and training code. Do not run more training or replace manuscript numerical results as part of this analysis.
